name: Shandong Xinhua Pharmac.Co.LtdR
summary: Shandong Xinhua Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is a pharmaceutical company engaged in the production and sale of pharmaceutical products and chemical intermediates. The company offers products including APIs (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients), preparations, and chemical products. Headquartered in Zibo, China, Shandong Xinhua Pharmaceutical distributes its products both domestically and internationally.
